solmisation.definition: n a system of naming the notes of a musical scale by syllables instead of letters

solmizate.definition:
v. sing by the syllables of solmization
v. sing using syllables like `do', `re' and `mi' to represent the tones of the scale

solmization.definition:
n. a system of naming the notes of a musical scale by syllables instead of letters
